theme: Open water today; the trip home still needs tying down.
greeting: The calendar's nearly clear, Dan -- one committee call this afternoon and otherwise open water. The weekend is where the work sits: the charter ends Saturday, and the route home from Cavtat through St Pete still has loose ends.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat departure still unarranged
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends noon Saturday at Komolac. The transfer to Cavtat, the bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and the pre-dawn checkout for Sunday's 7:30 AM flight are all still open -- and easiest to fix from shore while you have signal.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights Sept 20-21 have no room
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday from Croatia, but the two nights before the Tuesday school pickup still aren't booked anywhere in the St Pete area.

needsAttention.title: TPA rental not yet booked
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV for Sept 20 - Oct 5 is still open. It's now certain rather than a hedge, since the Pathfinder can't reach Florida until mid-October.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb locks in two days
needsAttention.detail: The $2,331 Sept 27 - Oct 5 booking charges Wednesday. A better price or location can still be swapped in until then; after that it's paid.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV, book this week
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. A refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

flagged.title: LinkedIn recruiter pings
flagged.detail: Connection requests from an executive-search consultant and a Deloitte policy contact, plus a public-affairs role alert -- worth a glance when you're back on land.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, campaign mail, and retail promos.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Orlando + Disney tickets, Sept 26-27 (all four girls)
Confirm Nautilus return transfer after disembarking

acts.line: Nothing's on the calendar before the afternoon -- the morning is entirely open water.
One fixed point: the NACD New England programming committee at 1.
The charter ends Saturday, and the loose bookings for the trip home are what's left waiting.
